name: DataHub MCP
description: Searches a DataHub data catalog and returns lineage, schemas, owners and metadata to AI agents, plus real SQL queries for grounded query writing.

skills.name: Search Catalog
skills.description: Searches the DataHub catalog with structured keyword syntax, boolean logic and filters to find tables, columns and dashboards.

skills.name: Get Lineage
skills.description: Retrieves upstream or downstream lineage for datasets, columns and dashboards, with filtering and hop control.

skills.name: Get Dataset Queries
skills.description: Fetches real SQL queries that reference a dataset or column to show its joins, filters and aggregation patterns.

skills.name: List Schema Fields
skills.description: Lists a dataset's schema fields with keyword filtering and pagination, for exploring large schemas field by field.

skills.name: Update Metadata
skills.description: Adds or removes tags, glossary terms, owners and domains on entities and columns when mutation tools are enabled.
